title: ChargeSplit — home energy & EV charging

panels.title: Grid now
panels.description: From the Zappi grid CT clamp. Negative = exporting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT grid_w / 1000.0 AS grid_kw FROM chargesplit.now
SELECT zappi_w / 1000.0 AS kw FROM chargesplit.now

panels.title: Tesla now
panels.description: Tesla charging at the home geofence, from TeslaMate's MQTT feed (sample < 3 min old).

targets.rawSql: SELECT tesla_w / 1000.0 AS kw FROM chargesplit.now
SELECT other_car_w / 1000.0 AS kw FROM chargesplit.now
SELECT rate_c FROM chargesplit.now
SELECT CONCAT(band, ' · ', COALESCE(zappi_status, 'no data')) AS status FROM chargesplit.now

panels.title: Live power (last 6 hours, every 30 s)
panels.description: 30-second readings: Zappi from myenergi, Tesla from TeslaMate's MQTT feed. Always shows the last 6 hours — see Power history below for any period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), avg(grid_w)/1000.0 AS "Grid", avg(zappi_w)/1000.0 AS "Zappi"
FROM chargesplit.live WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), avg(kw) AS "Tesla"
FROM chargesplit.tesla_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND charging AND chargesplit.is_home(geofence)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Power history (per minute, any period)
panels.description: Average power from the Zappi's per-minute history: grid import, and Zappi output split between the Tesla and Other car (one cable, so each minute belongs to one car). Zoom in for minute detail; longer periods are averaged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), avg(grid_kw) AS "Grid", avg(tesla_kw) AS "Tesla", avg(other_kw) AS "Other car"
FROM chargesplit.power_minute
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Charging cost per car, by month (last 12 months)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tesla_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE day >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')::date

panels.title: Other car — this month so far

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(other_car_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE day >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')::date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tesla_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE day >= (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin') - interval '1 month')::date AND NOT (day >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')::date)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(other_car_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE day >= (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin') - interval '1 month')::date AND NOT (day >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')::date)

panels.title: Cost to charge each car, per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', day), 'Mon YY') AS "Month",
  SUM(tesla_eur) AS "Tesla", SUM(other_car_eur) AS "Other car"
FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE day >= (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin') - interval '11 months')::date
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', day) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', day)

panels.title: Per car, per month (night % = share charged at the night rate)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', hour_local), 'Mon YYYY') AS "Month",
  SUM(tesla_kwh) AS "Tesla kWh", SUM(tesla_eur) AS "Tesla €",
  100 * SUM(tesla_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(tesla_kwh), 0) AS "Tesla c/kWh",
  100 * SUM(tesla_kwh) FILTER (WHERE band = 'night') / NULLIF(SUM(tesla_kwh), 0) AS "Tesla night %",
  SUM(other_car_kwh) AS "Other car kWh", SUM(other_car_eur) AS "Other car €",
  100 * SUM(other_car_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(other_car_kwh), 0) AS "Other car c/kWh",
  100 * SUM(other_car_kwh) FILTER (WHERE band = 'night') / NULLIF(SUM(other_car_kwh), 0) AS "Other car night %",
  SUM(tesla_eur) + SUM(other_car_eur) AS "Total charging €"
FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE hour_local >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin') - interval '11 months'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', hour_local) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', hour_local) DESC

panels.title: Share charged at night rate, per month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', hour_local), 'Mon YY') AS "Month",
  100 * SUM(tesla_kwh) FILTER (WHERE band = 'night') / NULLIF(SUM(tesla_kwh), 0) AS "Tesla",
  100 * SUM(other_car_kwh) FILTER (WHERE band = 'night') / NULLIF(SUM(other_car_kwh), 0) AS "Other car"
FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE hour_local >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin') - interval '11 months'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', hour_local) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', hour_local)

panels.title: Day-rate charging hours (selected period) — check these against when each car was plugged in

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(hour_local, 'Dy DD Mon HH24:00') AS "Hour",
  zappi_kwh AS "Zappi kWh", tesla_kwh AS "Tesla kWh", other_car_kwh AS "Other car kWh",
  (tesla_eur + other_car_eur) AS "Day-rate cost €"
FROM chargesplit.hourly
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc) AND band = 'day' AND zappi_kwh > 0.05
ORDER BY hour_utc DESC

panels.title: When each car was charging
panels.description: Tesla: from TeslaMate's MQTT feed (to ~30 s). Other car: from the Zappi's minute-by-minute data (to the minute); hourly blocks only where minute data isn't available.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS time, v AS "Tesla" FROM (
  SELECT start_utc AS t, 1 AS v FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE car = 'Tesla' AND COALESCE(end_utc, now()) >= $__timeFrom() AND start_utc <= $__timeTo()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(end_utc, now()), 0 FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE car = 'Tesla' AND COALESCE(end_utc, now()) >= $__timeFrom() AND start_utc <= $__timeTo()
) e ORDER BY 1

SELECT t AS time, v AS "Other car" FROM (
  SELECT start_utc AS t, 1 AS v FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE car = 'Other car' AND COALESCE(end_utc, now()) >= $__timeFrom() AND start_utc <= $__timeTo()
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(end_utc, now()), 0 FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE car = 'Other car' AND COALESCE(end_utc, now()) >= $__timeFrom() AND start_utc <= $__timeTo()
) e ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Start and end time of day for each session (shaded = night rate 23:00–08:00)
panels.description: Each dot is one charging session, plotted on the day it started. Y axis = local clock time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_utc AS time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) / 60.0 AS "Tesla start"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions
WHERE car = 'Tesla' AND start_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT start_utc AS time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (end_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (end_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) / 60.0 AS "Tesla end"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions
WHERE car = 'Tesla' AND end_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT start_utc AS time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) / 60.0 AS "Other car start"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions
WHERE car = 'Other car' AND start_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT start_utc AS time,
  EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (end_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (end_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin')) / 60.0 AS "Other car end"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions
WHERE car = 'Other car' AND end_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT car AS "Car",
  to_char(start_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') AS "Start",
  COALESCE(to_char(end_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Dublin', 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI'), 'charging now') AS "End",
  to_char(COALESCE(end_utc, now()) - start_utc, 'HH24"h "MI"m"') AS "Duration",
  kwh AS "kWh", cost_eur AS "Cost €", precision AS "Times"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY start_utc DESC
SELECT SUM(grid_import_kwh) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)

panels.title: Electricity bill (est.)
panels.description: Energy at day/night rate + standing charge. Excludes PSO levy and any credits.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT SUM(grid_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc))
 + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(standing_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day_start_utc)) AS eur
SELECT SUM(zappi_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT SUM(tesla_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT SUM(other_car_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)

SELECT 100 * (SELECT SUM(zappi_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(grid_eur) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc))
 + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(standing_eur),0) FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day_start_utc)),0)
SELECT SUM(tesla_kwh) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT SUM(other_car_kwh) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT SUM(house_kwh) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT 100 * SUM(zappi_kwh) FILTER (WHERE band='night') / NULLIF(SUM(zappi_kwh),0) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)
SELECT 100 * SUM(zappi_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(zappi_kwh),0) FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)

SELECT CONCAT('Grid: ', string_agg(DISTINCT import_source, ' + '), ' · v',
  (SELECT value FROM chargesplit.settings WHERE key = 'version')) AS src
FROM chargesplit.hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_utc)

SELECT day_start_utc AS time, tesla_kwh AS "Tesla", other_car_kwh AS "Other car",
 house_kwh AS "Rest of house" FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day_start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT day_start_utc AS time, tesla_eur AS "Tesla", other_car_eur AS "Other car",
 house_eur AS "Rest of house", standing_eur AS "Standing charge" FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day_start_utc) ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', day), 'Mon YYYY') AS "Month",
  SUM(grid_import_kwh) AS "Grid kWh", SUM(grid_night_kwh) AS "Night kWh", SUM(grid_day_kwh) AS "Day kWh",
  SUM(grid_eur) + SUM(standing_eur) AS "Bill €",
  SUM(tesla_kwh) AS "Tesla kWh", SUM(tesla_eur) AS "Tesla €",
  SUM(other_car_kwh) AS "Other car kWh", SUM(other_car_eur) AS "Other car €",
  SUM(house_eur) AS "House €"
FROM chargesplit.daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day_start_utc)
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', day) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', day) DESC

SELECT start_utc AS "Start", end_utc AS "End", kwh AS "kWh", cost_eur AS "Cost €",
  100 * cost_eur / NULLIF(kwh, 0) AS "c/kWh"
FROM chargesplit.charge_sessions WHERE car = 'Tesla' AND $__timeFilter(start_utc)
ORDER BY start_utc DESC
